resolved.title: 预处理运算符
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Preprocessor Operators[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The C preprocessor provides the following operators.

[h2]The # Operator[/h2]
The # macro operator is called the [b]stringification[/b] or [b]stringizing[/b] operator and tells the preprocessor to convert a parameter to a string constant.
White space on either side of the argument are ignored and escape sequences are recognized.

[s0l0!-header][b]For example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="c" codeId="2218"]#define TO_STR(x) [b]#x[/b]

printf("%s\n", TO_STR( 123\\12 ));[/code]
[note]Run the code and see how it works![/note]

resolved.question_text:
下面代码输出是？

```c
#define STR(x) #x
#define STRLEN(x) strlen(x)
printf("%d", STRLEN(STR(12345)));
```
resolved.question_text_html:
What is the output of the following code?
#define STR(x) #x
#define STRLEN(x) strlen(x)
printf("%d", STRLEN(STR(12345)));
